'''G. Zocolidae Amedus''' was a minor variant of the [[Zocolidae]] family of microscopic brown [[Worm/Legends|worms]].<ref name="SWG:STGZU">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Save Tatooine's G. Zocolidae Amedus!}}</ref>

At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an ongoing study on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by the [[Vinda'a BioChemical Laboratories]] focused on this variant. The study tried to find commercial applications for the worm's biological biochemistry that removed toxic chemicals from a planet's soil.<ref name="SWG:STGZU" />
